page.layout: One printed page, set sideways on the scan. Upper centre: a block of about ten capitalised lines, with a short gap and two more lines below. Lower centre: a title line, "P. RAMI DIALECTICAE", with a smaller line beneath it. No margin notes, running head or page number.
page.notes: The page is rotated about 90 degrees, and the print is faint and small at this scan resolution. Most lines could not be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The title line "P. RAMI DIALECTICAE" is a best reading and should be checked against the original. The lowest line is a short line of spaced capitals and could not be read.
